name: clip refused once — the sampling-flaky retry, then the poll loop
_why: The clip stage was the only billable stage no scenario reached: happy-path is a classic grade, so it reported clip:0 and the fixture's clip branch was code that looked alive and never ran — which is exactly the defect (an answer keyed `video` where the worker reads `data`) that made this fixture's first version test nothing. A movie grade with STORY_MOVIE=on is the only route to it. Shot 1 is refused once because Veo's safety filter is sampling-flaky on prompts that pass a moment later, which is why that rung is one retry and not a step-down.

job.prompt: a brave mouse in a bakery

plan.title: The Mouse Under the Bakery
plan.setting: a warm old bakery at night, flour dust in the lamplight

shots.still: A small brown mouse peers out from under a wooden floorboard.
shots.narration: Under the floorboards of an old bakery there lived a very small and very brave mouse.

shots.still: Wide view of the dark bakery, moonlight on the counters.
shots.narration: Every night when the baker went home, the mouse came out to see what the world had left behind.

shots.still: The mouse carries a crumb twice its size across the floor.
shots.narration: And every night she carried home one crumb, which to a mouse is a very great treasure indeed.

_expect._note: `still carries the shot` is forbidden because that is what a BROKEN clip fixture prints: the poll throws, the worker steps down, and the run still reports a finished film and a ledger of successful clip calls. It is the exact failure this scenario was added to catch.
